observations: Photo 0 shows a black tufted 3-seater style couch/sofa with gold-colored legs.
Photo 1 shows a similar black tufted sofa (appears 2-seater width) with gold-colored legs; a wall frame above it.
Photo 2 shows the black tufted 2-seater sofa from a different angle; visible seat cushion and arm shape; gold-colored legs.

identity.kind: 2 seater and 3 seater tufted couch/sofa set (black, gold legs)

claims.evidence: Photos show two matching tufted sofas: one wider (photo 0) and one narrower (photos 1 and 2).
No price shown in the photos; 'giveaway' is subjective and cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in photos (tears, worn foam, sagging cushions, broken springs).
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of seat cushions and backrest seams + a short video showing someone sitting/pressing each cushion to check bounce and sag.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used and possibly needing cushion/repair (worst-case: not fully comfortable / some wear).

risks.risk: Fabric/leather integrity (cracks, peeling, stains, odor) especially on the armrests and seat front.
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of armrests and the front seat edges in good light, plus a quick smell/cleanliness check video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as stained/marked or with unknown upholstery cleanliness (worst-case: needs cleaning).

risks.risk: Frame stability and leg condition (loose legs, wobble, damaged base).
risks.proof: Request a video of the sofa being gently rocked from the corners and a photo of the underside/legs.
risks.if_unproven: Price as may have minor wobble/leg wear (worst-case: needs tightening/repair).

risks.risk: Exact dimensions/true seating capacity (photos suggest 2-seater and 3-seater, but exact sizing can differ).
risks.proof: Request tape-measure photos: overall length, seat width, and seat depth for both sofas.
risks.if_unproven: Price based on typical 2-seater/3-seater sizes (worst-case: smaller than expected).

risks.risk: Whether both sofas are included in the same listing (seller says both, but photos could be partial).
risks.proof: Request confirmation that both items (2-seater + 3-seater) are available together, plus one photo showing both in the same frame or a screenshot of the listing showing both quantities.
risks.if_unproven: Price as only one sofa included (worst-case: you may receive just the 2-seater or just the 3-seater).

proof_requests: Close-up photos of upholstery (arms, seat fronts, backrest seams) for both sofas.
Short video showing cushion bounce/sag test (sit and press each cushion).
Video rocking test + underside/leg photos for both sofas.
Tape-measure photos for overall length and seat depth for both sofas.
Confirm both sofas are included together (2-seater + 3-seater) and not sold separately.
response.reason: The photos confirm a matching black tufted 2-seater and 3-seater sofa set, but key value drivers for used furniture (cushion condition, upholstery integrity, frame/leg stability, and whether both are included together) are not provable from these images alone.
